purpose: Prevent local worker completion, local commit SHAs, or PR metadata updates from being treated as durable Authority before independent remote readback.
authoritative_rule: Only REMOTE_READBACK_VERIFIED persistence evidence produced from an independent Control Room remote readback may unlock independent acceptance.

requirements: remote branch head equals worker output head
PR head equals remote branch head when a PR is bound
remote ancestry contains expected input head
remote ancestry contains expected input head
changed path set exactly matches the patch contract
every remote target blob SHA matches the patch target blob SHA
PR head equals remote branch head when a PR is bound
PATCH_RECONSTRUCTION.note: The reconstructed remote commit SHA may differ from the worker-local commit SHA; content identity, not local object identity, is authoritative.

worker_handoff_rule: Workers may end at WORKTREE_COMPLETE / PERSIST_PENDING / READY_FOR_INDEPENDENT_CONTROL_ROOM_RETEST but may never claim REMOTE_READBACK_VERIFIED or ACCEPTED.
owner_boundary: This contract does not authorize main merge, Production promotion, runtime-pointer switch, paid spend, or irreversible deployment.
